title: We Hacked Flock Safety Cameras in under 30 Seconds. 🫥
summary: Benn Jordan details security vulnerabilities in Flock Safety license-plate-reading cameras and how easily they can be compromised. It includes citations from security researchers and discussion of police surveillance.
why: HN recommends it, and Jordan's wider Flock series, as a well-documented look at the poor security of these surveillance cameras.

quote.text: This is an excellent video documenting some Flock camera vulnerabilities by Benn Jordan
